item.title: Psychology Daily · November 9, 2026
item.description: Today's thread is that psychological states are becoming readable signals — and readability is not the same as usefulness. A 92-country survey of 53,799 people puts the lows among young adults and richer countries; the full Instagram archives of 415 students separate emotional from social loneliness; and Wuhan has turned “work smell” into an eight-department clinic that saw 30,000 visits in three months. The more signals we have, the more insistently the same question returns: does any of this change an outcome? A 92-country survey of 53,799 people: mental wealth is lowest among the young and in richer countries
